ideas.children_he: אַבְרָהָם וְשָׂרָה עָבְרוּ לִגְרָר, וְאַבְרָהָם אָמַר שֶׁשָּׂרָה הִיא אֲחוֹתוֹ. כְּשֶׁפּוֹחֲדִים, לִפְעָמִים בּוֹחֲרִים לְהַסְתִּיר אֶת הָאֱמֶת.
ideas.children_en: Abraham moved to the Negev and lived in Gerar, a small Philistine town. He told Sarah to say she was his sister, like before in Egypt. Then King Abimelech took Sarah.

ideas.children_he: אֱלֹהִים הִזְהִיר אֶת אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בַּחֲלוֹם, וַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ הִסְבִּיר שֶׁלֹּא יָדַע אֶת הָאֱמֶת. חָשׁוּב לִבְדֹּק אִם מִישֶׁהוּ פָּעַל בְּכַוָּנָה.
ideas.children_en: God warned Abimelech in a dream that taking Abraham's wife would cost him his life. Abimelech did not touch Sarah and acted honestly. God told him to return Sarah and ask Abraham to pray for his life.

ideas.children_he: אֲבִימֶלֶךְ סִפֵּר לַאֲנָשָׁיו מַה קָּרָה, וְהֵם פָּחֲדוּ. מַעֲשִׂים שֶׁל מַנְהִיגִים מַשְׁפִּיעִים גַּם עַל הָאֲנָשִׁים שֶׁסְּבִיבָם.
ideas.children_en: Abimelech told his servants about the danger to the king, and they became very afraid.

ideas.children_he: אֲבִימֶלֶךְ שָׁאַל אֶת אַבְרָהָם מַדּוּעַ הִסְתִּיר אֶת הָאֱמֶת. כְּשֶׁמִּישֶׁהוּ נִפְגָּע, חָשׁוּב לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶת הַשְּׁאֵלוֹת שֶׁלּוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Abimelech blamed Abraham for causing a great sin on him and his kingdom. Abraham did not answer because he was not guilty, but Abimelech wanted to know Abraham's reason.

ideas.children_he: אַבְרָהָם הִסְבִּיר שֶׁפָּחַד לְחַיָּיו. פַּחַד הוּא רֶגֶשׁ טִבְעִי, אֲבָל הוּא לֹא תָּמִיד מוֹבִיל לְהַחְלָטָה טוֹבָה.
ideas.children_en: Abraham said he feared being killed because people there did not respect God. He said Sarah was his sister from his father's side and told her to say he was her brother to protect himself.

ideas.children_he: אֲבִימֶלֶךְ הֶחֱזִיר אֶת שָׂרָה וְנָתַן מַתָּנוֹת. כְּשֶׁמְּגַלִּים טָעוּת, חָשׁוּב לְנַסּוֹת לְתַקֵּן אוֹתָהּ.
ideas.children_en: Abimelech gave Abraham animals and servants and returned Sarah. He said Abraham could live there with no hate and gave money to honor Sarah and protect her from shame.

ideas.children_he: אַבְרָהָם הִתְפַּלֵּל בְּעַד אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וּמִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ. גַּם אַחֲרֵי מַחֲלֹקֶת אֶפְשָׁר לְבַקֵּשׁ טוֹבָה לַאֲחֵרִים.
ideas.children_en: Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelech, his wife, and servants. They were sick and could not have children while Sarah was with Abimelech.
